unit_note: USD millions. Table 5 uses dots for no transactions and (**) for amounts below $500,000 in absolute value. Both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. The Agricultural Disaster Relief Fund row contains only omission marks. The Farm Service Agency subtotal includes the numeric entries on the six remaining component rows. Agriculture program lines without a printed subtotal in this unit are included in the departmental unit.
